gui.firstcrusade.tip.governor.title: Appoint / Recall Governor
gui.firstcrusade.tip.governor.desc: Let the Governor run the city (recruit, build, grow) while you are away. Toggle to take back manual control.
gui.firstcrusade.tip.survey.title: Survey Build Border
gui.firstcrusade.tip.survey.desc: Show the city's build border (radius %s). New structures can only be built inside it.
gui.firstcrusade.reason.unclaimed_govern: Only an owned city can appoint a Governor.
msg.firstcrusade.governor.appointed: Lord-Governor %s now governs %s in your absence.
msg.firstcrusade.governor.recalled: You recalled Lord-Governor %s; you now command the city directly.
gui.firstcrusade.faction.title: Choose Your Allegiance
gui.firstcrusade.faction.subtitle: The Crusade demands a side. This choice is permanent.
gui.firstcrusade.faction.imperium.desc: Order, faith, and the God-Emperor's light.
gui.firstcrusade.faction.orks.desc: Brutal, loud, and always lookin' for a fight.
msg.firstcrusade.faction.chosen: You have pledged your allegiance to the %s.
gui.firstcrusade.tip.upgrade.title: Upgrade City
gui.firstcrusade.tip.upgrade.desc: Cost: %s Iron, %s Scrap, %s Coal, %s Crusadium Plate.
gui.firstcrusade.tip.upgrade.max: City is at the maximum level.
gui.firstcrusade.tip.mine.title: Build Imperial Mine
gui.firstcrusade.tip.mine.desc: Cost: 20 Iron, 10 Scrap, 5 Coal. Assigns a Miner who produces Iron.
gui.firstcrusade.tip.gold_mine.title: Build Gold Mine
gui.firstcrusade.tip.gold_mine.desc: Cost: 40 Iron, 25 Scrap, 15 Coal. Assigns a Gold Miner who produces Gold (slowly).
gui.firstcrusade.tip.scrap_yard.title: Build Scrap Yard
gui.firstcrusade.tip.scrap_yard.desc: Cost: 15 Iron, 5 Coal. Assigns a Scrapper who produces Scrap Metal.
gui.firstcrusade.tip.forge.title: Build Imperial Forge
gui.firstcrusade.tip.forge.desc: Cost: 30 Iron, 20 Scrap, 10 Coal. Assigns a Smith who forges Crusadium Plate (4 Iron, 3 Scrap, 2 Coal each).
gui.firstcrusade.tip.refinery.title: Build Promethium Refinery
gui.firstcrusade.tip.refinery.desc: Cost: 18 Iron, 8 Scrap. Assigns a Stoker who produces Coal.
gui.firstcrusade.tip.farm.title: Build Imperial Farm
gui.firstcrusade.tip.farm.desc: Cost: 15 Iron, 5 Scrap. Assigns a Farmer; staffed farms feed the city (morale + growth).
gui.firstcrusade.tip.trade_depot.title: Build Emerald Trade Depot
gui.firstcrusade.tip.trade_depot.desc: Cost: 30 Iron, 15 Scrap, 10 Coal. Assigns a Trader who trades Gold for Emerald (4 Gold each).
gui.firstcrusade.tip.barracks.title: Build Imperial Barracks
gui.firstcrusade.tip.barracks.desc: Cost: 25 Iron, 15 Scrap, 5 Coal. Trains Recruits into Guardsmen.
gui.firstcrusade.tip.recruit.title: Recruit
gui.firstcrusade.tip.recruit.desc: Assigns the nearest unemployed Citizen as a Recruit to train at a Barracks into a Guardsman.
gui.firstcrusade.tip.cycle_specialist.de: Selects the specialist type for Promote Specialist. Selected: %s.
Promotes the nearest Guardsman to the selected specialist role. Costs Iron, Scrap and War Support.
gui.firstcrusade.tip.repair.title: Repair Core
gui.firstcrusade.tip.repair.desc: Cost: 1 Crusadium Plate. Restores Core integrity.
gui.firstcrusade.tip.reinforcements.desc: Cost: %s War Support. Deploys emergency Guardsmen during a raid.
gui.firstcrusade.tip.rally.title: Rally Defenders
gui.firstcrusade.tip.rally.desc: Repositions assigned Guardsmen back to defend the Core.
gui.firstcrusade.tip.fortify.title: Fortify Defenders
gui.firstcrusade.tip.fortify.desc: Cost: %s War Support. Buffs assigned defenders.
gui.firstcrusade.tip.force_raid.title: Force Raid (Test)
gui.firstcrusade.tip.force_raid.desc: Immediately triggers an Ork raid for testing.
gui.firstcrusade.tip.deposit.title: Deposit All Resources
gui.firstcrusade.tip.deposit.desc: Moves Iron, Coal, Scrap, Gold, Emerald and Crusadium from your inventory into the city. Compressed blocks (Iron/Coal/Gold/Emerald) count as 9 each.
gui.firstcrusade.tip.withdraw.title: Withdraw %s
gui.firstcrusade.tip.withdraw.desc: Takes up to 64 %s into your inventory. Stored: %s.
